isRelative.description: Weather or not this is a relative path. I.e. it doesn't start with '/' character.

isDirectory.description: Weather or not this is a directory path. I.e. it ends with '/' character.

title:
A "restful path" is a specification used with the {@link Ann.Restful @restful} annotation to map a request path to
a method for invocation from the API.

This looks like a normal URL path, but path elements (slash separated) may be replaced with a variable name prefixed
with colon (`:`). For example: "type/:name" requests the path to start with literal "type/", but will pass anything
after the slash as the value for the parameter "name".

If a parameter appears in the middle of the path, it will only match to the next slash, allowing multiple parameters
to be used, for example "type/:typeName/field/:fieldName".
name: RestfulPath
